g.text: Eight GLSL passes. Shallow water, Runge–Kutta 2, on the GPU.
Each cell stores w, hu, hv in one RGB32F texture. Two framebuffers swap every pass.
Bathymetry — Kinect depth becomes the terrain texture.
Slope and flux — Kurganov–Petrova. Water wants to run downhill.
Euler step — Runge–Kutta predictor. A first guess at the next moment.
Slope and flux — Same pass again, on that prediction.
Runge–Kutta — The corrector. Average the guess with the correction.
Boundary — The edges of the box stay dry.
Rain and evaporation — Hands add water. Lakes are allowed to dry.
Render — A blue sheet on the sand, plus the erosion marks.
taller than the sand beside it.
